sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to maintain their impressive form. The leaders are unbeaten in their last five games (W-D-W-W-W) and sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 matches. Alsager Town arrive in poor shape, winless in their last five and rooted to the foot of the division with just 4 points from 10 games, making this a heavily favoured fixture for the hosts.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host bottom-club Widnes Town in what should be a comfortable outing for the visitors; Widnes remain pointless in the league. Nearby at the summit, Wolverhampton Casuals (19 pts, 4th) face Wednesfield Community (13 pts, 9th) in a local derby where the visitors will be favoured despite recent inconsistency. AFC Bridgnorth (3rd, 19 pts) travel to Eccleshall (5th, 18 pts) in a tight mid-table battle, while Bilston Town (6th, 17 pts) visit Foley Meir (11th, 11 pts) in another fixture tilted towards the higher-ranked side. Barnton (7th, 15 pts) host Shawbury United (15th, 10 pts) in a fixture where the hosts should have the edge, though Shawbury's form has been alarming with one win in their last five. New Mills (8th, 14 pts) travel to Market Drayton Town (10th, 12 pts), while Telford Town (18th, 6 pts) are away at Cheadle Heath Nomads (17th, 7 pts) in a basement battle. Finally, Crewe (16th, 9 pts) host Allscott Heath (11th, 11 pts) in another lower-table clash. Brereton Social (14th, 11 pts) complete the slate against Widnes Town, though as noted Widnes remain bottom with just 2 points.
